verdict.rationale: The docs say CockroachDB Cloud offers Serverless/Basic clusters whose Request Unit consumption "scales to zero when your cluster has no activity", and RU-based Standard clusters, which implies usage-based elastic compute. Horizontal scaling is also claimed, but nothing explicitly states that compute scales up automatically under load without manual resizing or downtime. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of automatic scale-up with load, a no-downtime guarantee during scaling, details on autoscaling limits or behavior, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
